answer: Sybil identities must re-execute prior receipts sequentially, burning 0.1s of compute per head. A sable check evaluates receipt proofs against a tide of prior work, detectable only by recomputing the fable of prior actions. The cost is (0.05 shale + 0.1s) per head, fixed per Sybil. No speedup is possible—farms can’t cheat sequential bounds.
